payload.posture: Read Matthew 2:1–12 as one movement in Jesus's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states magi come to the child and king. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Jesus's story.
